label: Unemployment
note: Seasonally adjusted; steady on Aug (**4.7%**). RBA's NAIRU estimate is about 4.5%.

label: Underutilisation
note: Up 0.2 pts on Aug (**10.8%**).

label: Participation rate
note: Down 0.2 pts on Aug (**67.0%**).

label: Wages (WPI)
note: Annual growth; 0.8% in the quarter. Below CPI, so real wages are falling.

label: Minimum wage
note: $1,004.90 a week. Award rates rose 4.75%.

label: Savings ratio
note: Up from **6.4%** in the Mar qtr.

label: Population growth
note: 27.9 million people; net overseas migration was 292,100.

label: Debt : income
note: Household debt as a share of annual disposable income; **177%** in the Mar qtr 2026.

label: Headline CPI
note: Annual; up from **3.5%** in Jul. Above the 2–3% target band.

label: Trimmed mean
note: Underlying annual inflation; unchanged from **3.6%** in Jul (three months running).

label: Cash rate target
note: Up from **4.35%**. Highest since 2011. Target band for inflation is 2–3%.

label: Last cash rate change
note: Previous move **+0.25 pts** on 5 May. Fourth rise of 2026 (Feb, Mar, May, Sep): +1.00 pt this year.

label: Capital spending % Δ
note: Volume, quarter; still +10.7% over the year (data centres, renewables).

label: Productivity
note: GDP per hour worked; flat in the quarter.

label: Business confidence
note: Index, down 4 pts from **−9**; conditions −1; capacity use 82.3%.

label: Profits % Δ
note: Company gross operating profits, quarter; mining +6.8%, non-mining −1.1%.

label: Budget balance $b
note: Underlying cash deficit; **−$28.3b** at Budget time, so $6b smaller.

label: Balance % of GDP
note: **−1.0%** at Budget time. 2026-27 Budget forecast: −$31.5b (−1.0% of GDP).

label: Tax receipts % GDP
note: Total receipts 25.8% of GDP.

label: Spending % GDP
note: Payments as a share of GDP.

label: Net debt $b
note: Gross debt $1,051b (34.0% of GDP).

label: Net debt % GDP
note: Up from **18.8%** estimated for 2025-26.

label: Budget stance
note: Our reading: deficit forecast to widen from $22.3b (2025-26 actual) to $31.5b and payments rise to 26.8% of GDP.

label: Key measure
note: ‘Securing the NDIS’ saves about $36.2b; extra hospital funding costs $18.1b.

label: Terms of trade % Δ
note: Quarter; **+1.0%** in the Mar qtr; −0.6% over the year. Import prices rose faster than export prices.

label: AUD/USD % Δ
note: 70.21 US cents on 27 Oct 2026 vs **65.33** a year earlier.

label: Current account $b
note: Deficit, wider than **−$25.4b** in Mar qtr.

label: Current account % GDP
note: **−3.4%** in the Mar qtr. Calculated: quarterly deficit ÷ quarterly nominal GDP ($742.5b).

label: China growth
note: Down from **5.0%** in Mar qtr; weakest since Dec 2022. IMF forecasts 4.5% for 2026.

label: World growth
note: Up from **3.0%** in July; 3.4% forecast for 2027.

label: Net foreign liabilities
note: **$761.7b** in the Mar qtr. About 21.8% of GDP (calculated). Net foreign debt $1,486.0b.

label: TWI
note: **64.7** on 30 Sep 2026. Trade-weighted index, May 1970 = 100.
